fromLine.description: first line of the page, from 1 (default 1); use nextLine from the previous page

maxBytes.description: page size: bytes of the page once masked, escaped and encoded as JSON text, 1024 to 4194304 (default 153600); a line longer than the page is refused with the size to ask for

bytes.description: size of the whole policy: as the API returned it with personalData show; otherwise as shown, every page joined, so it cannot confirm a guessed address

etag.description: the policy version's ETag, verbatim; only with personalData show, since it may be derived from the unmasked file

externallyManaged.description: true, false or unknown: whether the policy is managed outside the admin console, for example by GitOps

masked.description: email addresses on this page were masked

nextLine.description: fromLine of the next page; 0 on the last page

policy.description: lines fromLine to toLine of the policy file (HuJSON, comments included) as the API returned it, line ends shown as LF; email addresses masked unless personalData is show

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole policy, of the same bytes as bytes
